title: add ci sbom generation, cosign signing, and release-manifests provenance for private-installer
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add SBOM generation (syft), cosign signing, and release-manifests provenance to the private-installer release pipeline. This PR updates the release workflow to produce syft SBOMs, attach them to artifacts, cosign-sign images and manifests, and emit a releases/manifest.json with provenance metadata (build id, builder, input checksums). Motivation: customers deploying Private in regulated environments requested verifiable provenance and signed artifacts for air-gapped installs; this PR extends previous artifact-signing work by formalizing SBOM generation, adding manifest-level provenance, and ensuring Helm/Terraform templates can consume pinned image digests. The description below summarizes commits, files changed, CI checks, review thread, and merge details.
commits: build(ci): add syft sbom generation step to release workflow
feat(ci): add cosign signing step and gpg/cosign helpers
chore(manifests): emit release-manifests.json with provenance and artifact digests
fix(helm): surface imageDigest fields in values and templates
docs: document release manifest format and signing verification steps
review_comments: Evan Morris: Please avoid writing secrets into action logs; use AAD/secret manager and reference via steps.env. Also add a retry on cosign pushes when registry transient 429s occur.
Aisha Patel: addressed by using COSIGN_PASSWORD from GitHub Secrets and adding exponential backoff in cosign-sign-artifacts.sh (retry x3).
Priya Rao: Can we include the STRIGI provenance fields (build_id, builder, inputs_checksum)? Add formats to docs so customers can validate.
Aisha Patel: Added release-manifests.json schema to docs/private-installer/release-provenance.md and included build_id, builder, inputs_checksum, sbom_sha256 and signed_manifests entries.
Jonah Blake: CI failed on first run due to missing syft binary in runner image; recommend caching syft or using container action.
comment_author_replies: Aisha Patel: switched to the syft action container to avoid installing syft on-host and added a simple cache for downloaded syft binary when container not available.
Aisha Patel: added terraform variable image_digest and updated helm values to allow digest pinning for air-gapped installs.
release_notes: Produce SBOMs (syft) for private-installer artifacts; add cosign signing for images and release manifests; emit release-manifests.json with provenance metadata; Helm values updated to support image digest pinning; CI updates to generate and validate provenance during release builds.
additional_context: This PR builds on prior work that introduced artifact signing for the Private Installer; it formalizes the provenance format used by customers during air-gapped installs and adds verification documentation. Operators using the installer should update their release pipelines to consume release-manifests.json and verify cosign signatures and SBOM checksums before performing offline installs. Terraform users should set the new image_digest variable when pinning images for offline registries.
